source_clauses.verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp fixes the monitor arm to the desk edge.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp accommodates desk edges with thickness in the range 18 to 40 mm.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
requirements.observable_verbatim: After tightening, the clamp remains stationary (no slip or rotation) when the arm's weight is applied.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp can be removed and reattached to another desk without using any tools.

scenarios.name: Clamping to desk edge
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the clamp and the monitor arm. Outside: the desk edge (including the desk surface it contacts) and the environment (e.g., floor, walls) that ultimately supports the desk.
scenarios.environment: Desk environment with edge thickness between 18 and 40 mm.

scenarios.name: In service under arm weight
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the clamp, the monitor arm, and the monitor (if attached). Outside: the desk (including the edge) and the surrounding space, which provides reaction forces.
scenarios.environment: Desk with edge thickness between 18 and 40 mm, arm weight applied.

scenarios.name: Removal and relocation
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the clamp and possibly the monitor arm if it is removed together. Outside: the desk and any tools (which are not used). The environment includes other desks.
scenarios.environment: Two separate desks with edge thickness in the stated range.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism by which the clamp fixes the arm to the desk (e.g., screw, lever, cam) is not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not state any preferred mechanism.

freedoms.decision: The material of the clamp is not specified.
The exact shape and size of the clamp (beyond accommodating 18-40 mm desk thickness) are not specified.
freedoms.why_free: No dimensions are given except the desk thickness range.

freedoms.decision: How the clamp attaches to the monitor arm (e.g., via a standard VESA interface, a custom bracket) is not specified.
freedoms.why_free: The text only says 'fixes a monitor arm', no attachment details.

ambiguities.statement: The text does not specify what 'tight' means in terms of force, torque, or method.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: The clamp design is determined or the user clarifies the expected tightening procedure.

ambiguities.statement: The type of monitor arm and its weight are not specified, so 'weight of the arm' is ambiguous regarding magnitude and distribution.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: The specific monitor arm model or maximum weight is provided.

ambiguities.statement: The phrase 'without any tools' could include no manual tools, but it might allow for integrated levers or mechanisms that are part of the clamp.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: Requirement interpretation is clarified: whether integrated mechanisms count as 'tools'.

assumptions.statement: The desk edge is a straight, homogeneous feature without obstructions.
assumptions.why: The text does not mention any irregularities on the desk edge.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the user's desk has curved edges, cutouts, or other features.

assumptions.statement: The clamp is intended to hold the monitor arm in a fixed orientation once tightened, and the arm is not being adjusted during the operation.
assumptions.why: The text says 'once it is tight it must not slip or rotate', implying a static state.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the arm is meant to be repositioned without loosening the clamp.

assumptions.statement: The clamp is operated manually, and no power tools are used.
assumptions.why: The request mentions 'without any tools' for relocation, and typical clamps are hand-adjusted.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the user intends to use electric or pneumatic tools for tightening.
